content:
Apple is rolling out the third developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate to developers, just weeks before its launch. Here's what's new.

macOS 27.2 beta 3 now rolling out to developers

Two weeks ago, Apple released the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, followed by the first public beta of the same version.

The biggest user-facing addition to the macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta cycle is expanded language support for Siri AI. Previously, when macOS 27 Golden Gate launched last month, Siri AI only supported English.

As Apple promised at its Surprise and Shine event, Siri AI will gain French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish support in macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

Apple skipped the macOS 27.1 Golden Gate beta cycle entirely, jumping straight to 27.2. The unusual version numbering is likely related to development on the iPhone Duo — Apple wanted to keep details under wraps ahead of the device's official unveiling earlier this month.

We're testing out today's new beta in detail and will share any noteworthy findings.

How to install macOS 27.2 beta 3

Here's how to install the first macOS 27.2 beta 3:

  • Back up your Mac
  • Open System Settings
  • Go to General ⇾ Software Update
  • Tap the 'i' icon next to Beta Updates
  • Select macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta from the dropdown menu in the top right corner
  • Tap 'Done'

Have you spotted any new features in macOS 27.2 Golden Gate developer beta 3? Drop them in the comments below.

  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 5
  • AirTag (2nd Generation) — 4-Pack
  • MacBook Neo
  • Logitech MX Master 4
